text:
Amanda: Heads-up — we should add explicit SLO labels so routing can decide tenant fallbacks. current fanout to oncall is noisy and hides real pager-worthy alerts.
Brian: Are we talking notify API changes or just console UI tags?
Amanda: API-first. console needs to surface the label + a 'noise' score. teams should be able to mark SLOs as 'non-critical' without losing visibility.
Vikram: We have per-route priority today but notify fanout budget is global. Proposal: add optional `slo_labels` field in notify payload. Example:
```json
{"slo_id":"latency:99p","labels":{"workload":"ingest","tenant_role":"batch","priority":"low"}}
```
Jess: +1 to optional. don't break existing consumers. default behavior should remain unchanged if labels absent.
Maria: Telemetry wise we need an 'alert_noise_score' metric per SLO and a sample_rate tag so console can show noisy candidates. Without that, the UI won't be able to recommend quiet-windows.
deploy-bot: Deployed slo-labels-proto v0.2 to staging :rocket:
Brian: UX thought — on SLO card show a small 'routing hint' pill (label value) and a dropdown to choose fallback tier (default / reduced-fanout / silent). :eyes:
Vikram: Implementation note — per-label token buckets are expensive. we could hash labels into a small set of buckets and apply per-bucket budgets. tradeoff: some leakage but cheaper.
Jess: I can run a simulated workload to validate bucket collision rates. would like a small flag to enable label->bucket mapping in staging.
Amanda: Please run sims for top 50 tenants and upload results. Also add a migration plan for existing SLOs without labels.
Brian: Created ticket PLATFORM-8423 with initial acceptance criteria: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PLATFORM-8423
Maria: Also we should record when a console-action (quiet-window or override) was applied so evasion/spam can be audited.
Amanda: Agreed. next steps: (1) Vikram prototype bucket mapping, (2) Jess run sims, (3) Maria add telemetry hooks, (4) Brian add UI mockups. Ping me when staging results are in.
Jess: Will do, starting sims today. :thumbsup:
Amanda: Thanks — if staging looks good we can canary the API to a subset of tenants.
